# LAMMPS Input Script for Aluminum Slab Relaxation

units metal
atom_style atomic

# Read data file
read_data /results/10_feb_melting/gpt_4o/tool_calling/surface_energy/subtask/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_3/aluminum_structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Replicate the unit cell
replicate 5 5 5

# Define simulation box with non-periodic boundary in z-direction
change_box all boundary p p f

# Minimization settings
min_style cg
min_modify dmax 0.1 line quadratic
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step pe lx ly lz

# Dump relaxed structure
write_data relaxed_structure.data
